title: ULTRON Computer-Node Protocol
description: The wire contract between the ULTRON server gateway (app/agents/computer/gateway.py) and a computer node (clients/desktop-node/). One JSON object per WebSocket text frame; every object carries a `type` discriminator. This document is normative: the server's Pydantic models are a typed view of it, and tests/unit/test_node_protocol.py asserts the two agree field-for-field.

NodeType.title: NodeType
NodeType.description: The node inventory (spec 64.5). The set is closed; `future` is the escape hatch so a new kind can register without a schema change.

ResultStatus.title: ResultStatus
ResultStatus.description: The outcome of one command, from the node.

MessageType.title: MessageType
MessageType.description: The `type` discriminator on every wire message.

Capability.title: Capability
Capability.description: The capability families a node may advertise (spec 64.6.2 Windows, 64.7 server, 64.9 ESP32). Advisory: a node may advertise a string not in this list and the registry stores it.

NodeRegistration.title: NodeRegistration
NodeRegistration.description: The first message a node sends: who it is, what it can do, and the node credential that authenticates it (spec 64.13: a node credential authenticates a node, never a user).

credential.description: The opaque node credential; hashed at rest and never echoed back.

ServerHello.title: ServerHello
ServerHello.description: The server's answer to a registration: accepted or not, and the rules that follow. A refusal is a normal handshake outcome (accepted=false), not a server fault.

NodeHeartbeat.title: NodeHeartbeat
NodeHeartbeat.description: A periodic liveness message; may refresh the advertised capabilities or status.

NodeHeartbeatAck.title: NodeHeartbeatAck
NodeHeartbeatAck.description: The server's answer to a heartbeat: liveness acknowledged, with the server clock so the node can detect drift.

NodeCommand.title: NodeCommand
NodeCommand.description: One structured command. There is no arbitrary shell string (spec 13): the node dispatches on `tool` and passes `arguments` to that tool's implementing handler.

principal.description: Who asked, for the node-side permission re-check (spec 64.6.3 Path B).

deadline.description: Absolute deadline; the node should abandon the work once past it.

NodeResult.title: NodeResult
NodeResult.description: The node's answer to one command, correlated by `command_id`. `ok` carries `result`; `error` carries `error` and optionally `error_code`.

NodeCapabilities.title: NodeCapabilities
NodeCapabilities.description: The capability/state view of one node. The shape `GET /nodes` and `GET /nodes/{id}` return.

Goodbye.title: Goodbye
Goodbye.description: Either side closes politely. The server still treats a dropped socket as a disconnect (spec 64.14), so this is a courtesy, not the mechanism.
